name: Smart Brands for WooCommerce
author: ShapedPlugin LLC

sections.description:
Live Demo | Documentation | Support | Upgrade to Pro »

Overview

Smart Brands for WooCommerce helps you display product brands beautifully in your WooCommerce store. Show each brand’s name, description, and logo on product pages, on brand archive pages, and in a carousel or grid anywhere on your site.

The plugin works with WooCommerce’s built-in product brand taxonomy, so your brands stay fully compatible with WooCommerce core and keep all the benefits of WordPress taxonomies. A simple shortcode generator with live preview lets you build and customize brand showcases without writing any code, and you can place them with a shortcode, the Gutenberg block, or the Elementor addon.

Smart Brands for WooCommerce is free, actively maintained, and backed by friendly support.

Why use Smart Brands for WooCommerce?

A product’s brand has a real impact on how customers judge its value. If your store sells products from well-known brands, featuring those brands prominently builds trust and helps shoppers find what they are looking for.

With Smart Brands for WooCommerce you can add a name, logo, description, and custom link to each brand, give every brand its own archive page, and assign brands to your products. The result is a more polished, professional store that is easier to browse by brand.

Features

  • Minimalist, fully responsive design
  • Create unlimited brands
  • Set a name and description for each brand
  • Upload a logo or image for each brand
  • Add custom links to brands
  • Assign one or more brands to each product
  • Show brands on the shop page and single product page
  • Brand archive pages
  • Works with the WooCommerce core brand taxonomy
  • Shortcode generator with live preview
  • Carousel and responsive grid layouts
  • Gutenberg block and Elementor addon
  • Display the product count for each brand
  • Device-specific responsive controls
  • Order brands by name, date, or random
  • Show or hide the section title
  • Set the space between brands
  • Vertical alignment (top, middle, bottom) and inner padding options
  • Brand border, border style, color, hover color, and border radius
  • Carousel powered by Swiper for fast, smooth sliding
  • Carousel controls:
    • Autoplay and autoplay speed
    • Sliding speed
    • Pause on hover
    • Infinite loop
    • Slides to scroll, with separate settings for responsive devices
    • Free mode
    • Show or hide navigation, with navigation color and padding options
    • Show or hide pagination dots, with pagination color options
    • Touch swipe, mouse dragging, and mousewheel control
  • Display brands in sidebars and widgets
  • Change the brand taxonomy label
  • Custom CSS option to override styles
  • Compatible with popular page builders
  • RTL supported
  • Multisite supported
  • Translation ready
  • Compatible with popular WooCommerce themes and plugins
  • Compatible with WooCommerce High-Performance Order Storage (HPOS)
  • Works in all modern browsers

Support, Feature Requests, and Bug Reports

Need help, have an idea, or found a bug? Contact us through our Support page.

We’re proud to help extend WooCommerce.

Author

Designed and developed by ShapedPlugin.
sections.installation:
Automatic installation (easiest)

  1. Log in to your WordPress dashboard and go to Plugins > Add New Plugin.
  2. Search for “Smart Brands for WooCommerce” by ShapedPlugin.
  3. Click “Install Now”, then “Activate”.

Upload in the WordPress dashboard

  1. Download smart-brands-for-woocommerce.zip.
  2. Go to Plugins > Add New Plugin and click “Upload Plugin”.
  3. Select smart-brands-for-woocommerce.zip from your computer.
  4. Click “Install Now”, then activate the plugin.

Install using FTP

  1. Download smart-brands-for-woocommerce.zip and extract it on your computer.
  2. Upload the smart-brands-for-woocommerce folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  3. Activate the plugin from the Plugins page in your dashboard.
sections.faq:
How does this plugin relate to WooCommerce’s built-in brands?

Since version 2.0.1, Smart Brands for WooCommerce uses the WooCommerce core product brand taxonomy. Brands created with earlier versions of the plugin were migrated to WooCommerce brands automatically, so there is no duplicate brand taxonomy.

Will I lose my brands when I update from version 1.x?

No. When you update to version 2.0.1 or later, your existing brands are migrated to WooCommerce brands. As with any major update, we recommend backing up your site first.

How do I display a brand carousel or grid?

Create a brand showcase in the plugin’s shortcode generator, choose the carousel or grid layout, and save it. Then add it to any page using its shortcode, the Smart Brands Gutenberg block, or the Elementor addon.

Where do brands appear on my product pages?

Brands can be shown on the shop page and the single product page. You can control how they appear in the plugin’s Shop Page and Product Page settings.

Can I change the brand label?

Yes. The plugin settings include an option to change the brand taxonomy label.

Is the plugin compatible with HPOS?

Yes. Smart Brands for WooCommerce is compatible with WooCommerce High-Performance Order Storage.
